PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Ceramic Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ceramic Materials.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Ceramic Materials.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ceramic Materials.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ceramic Materials.

2. When learning Dimensioning, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Dimensioning.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Dimensioning.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Dimensioning.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Dimensioning.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Overload every socket

4. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Run with the tool

5. When learning Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .

6. When learning Cutting Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Cutting Tools.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cutting Tools.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cutting Tools.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cutting Tools.

7. When learning Computer Software, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Software.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Software.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Software.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Software.

8. When learning Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.

9. When learning Data Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Safety.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Safety.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Safety.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Data Safety.

10. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Speaker
   C. Monitor
   D. CPU

11. When learning Plane Geometry, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Plane Geometry.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Cutting Tools and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Computer Software and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
